objective: Evaluate proposed long-term memory candidates for duplicate/stale/conflicting status against the accepted memory corpus, and flag problem candidates for human review. Advisory only — never merges, deletes, or accepts memory; makes no determination.

summary.migrator_change: None — reuses the reserved V38 second_brain_memory_quality_review_runs table. Schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.
summary.reuse: memory/store (read candidates, write_memory_item), memory/curator (propose_memory_candidate), memory/policy (classify_memory_tier -> T3_CONFLICT_DETECTED), the eval_set.py persister pattern.

design.detection: Statements are SHA256-hashed (never raw). duplicate = statement-hash matches an accepted item (or another candidate); stale = matches a superseded item; conflicting = review_tier_reason_code == T3_CONFLICT_DETECTED (the deterministic curator conflict code).
design.read_only: Reads candidates + accepted/superseded items via mode=ro SQL (zero writes); emit_receipt defaults False (no operator-DB write); the run row is persisted only on emit_receipt (exercised in the proof on a temp DB).
design.doctrine: Advisory — makes_determination=false, merges_or_deletes_or_accepts=false, routes_flagged_to_review=true. Metadata-only: hashed per-candidate flag records, counts, review vocabulary — no raw statement text. Fail-closed on missing policy / stale schema.

operator_db_outcome.rationale: The operator DB has 1 proposed memory candidate; it is clean (not duplicate/stale/conflicting). emit_receipt defaulted False -> nothing persisted.
